release_notes: Build 128 stabilizes the Library page so background status checks no longer keep rebinding columns or reapplying widths.
The older 30-second Library publication timer is stopped and the Build 127 platform timer now refreshes data only; layout is constructed once and then frozen.
The one-second general UI cleanup no longer mutates Library columns after the final layout is ready.
YT / FB / IG values continue to refresh live, but the grid is repainted only when a platform status actually changes.
The compact FB / IG tick-cross display, wider Stage / Next action columns and automatic Instagram follow-through remain unchanged.
